questionText: Two trains running in opposite directions cross a man standing on the platform in 37 seconds and 10 seconds, respectively, and they cross each other in 25 seconds. The ratio of their speeds is:
solutionText:
Train 1 Time          Train 2 Time  hello fire
    37 sec               10 sec
             \        /
              25 sec (Cross Time)
             /        \
  (25 - 10)            (37 - 25)
   = 15                  = 12
